stories.title: Saudi-Kuwaiti panel discusses joint security initiatives

en.title: Saudi-Kuwaiti panel discusses joint security initiatives
en.summary: Saudi and Kuwaiti interior ministry officials co-chaired the third meeting of their Military and Security Coordination Committee to discuss joint security initiatives and strengthen cooperation between the two nations.

stories.title: UN condemns continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, urges restraint

en.title: UN condemns continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, urges restraint
en.summary: The United Nations condemned ongoing Houthi cross-border attacks against Saudi Arabia, including attempted strikes on Riyadh and attacks on civilians and energy infrastructure, and called for restraint from all parties.

stories.title: Arab League denounces Al-Aqsa incursion under Israeli police protection

en.title: Arab League denounces Al-Aqsa incursion under Israeli police protection
en.summary: The Arab League condemned an Israeli official and settlers entering Al-Aqsa Mosque under Israeli force protection, reaffirming rejection of violations to holy sites and their legal status.

stories.title: Ibero-American International Film Festival kicks off in Riyadh

en.title: Ibero-American International Film Festival kicks off in Riyadh
en.summary: The fifth Ibero-American International Film Festival began in Riyadh, showcasing cinema from 13 countries including Brazil, Spain, Mexico, and Portugal. The event runs until October 8 at the Embassy of India auditorium.

stories.title: Hegra Highlights Status as Saudi Arabia’s First UNESCO World Heritage Site

en.title: Hegra Highlights Status as Saudi Arabia's First UNESCO World Heritage Site
en.summary: Hegra is recognized as Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns Israeli incursion into Al-Aqsa Mosque

en.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns Israeli incursion into Al-Aqsa Mosque
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry condemned the storming of Al-Aqsa Mosque by an Israeli official and settlers under occupation forces, describing it as a violation and provocation to Muslims worldwide.

stories.title: Red Sea International Film Festival postpones sixth edition to late 2027

en.title: Red Sea International Film Festival postpones sixth edition to late 2027
en.summary: The Red Sea International Film Festival's sixth edition has been postponed to the fourth quarter of 2027. The foundation will continue year-round activities and introduce new programs beginning in November 2026.

stories.title: Saudi FM Discusses Regional Developments in Calls with Kuwaiti, Egyptian, and Turkish Counterparts

en.title: Saudi FM Discusses Regional Developments in Calls with Kuwaiti, Egyptian, and Turkish Counterparts
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister held telephone conversations with officials from Kuwait, Egypt, and Turkey to discuss regional matters.

stories.title: Crown Prince launches CEER’s first electric vehicles, EXOBOT sedan and SUV

en.title: Crown Prince launches CEER's first electric vehicles, EXOBOT sedan and SUV
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman launched EXOBOT, the first electric vehicles from CEER, the kingdom's national automotive company. The launch represents progress in developing Saudi Arabia's automotive industry and industrial base.

en.title: WAMY Commends Saudi Arabia's Efforts to Support Peace, Security, Stability
en.summary: WAMY has praised Saudi Arabia's efforts in supporting peace, security, and stability.

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince Launches CEER's Flagship Vehicles
en.summary: The Saudi Crown Prince unveiled flagship vehicles from CEER.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia issued a condemnation regarding Israeli officials and settlers entering Al-Aqsa courtyards.

stories.title: ‎Eastern Pipes: New contract with Aramco not linked to emergency repairs

en.title: Eastern Pipes: New contract with Aramco not linked to emergency repairs
en.summary: Eastern Pipes secured a 770 million SAR contract from Saudi Aramco for the East-West Pipeline project, which was planned separately from emergency repairs and followed standard evaluation procedures.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 17
en.summary: Significant ownership changes are scheduled to occur on the Tadawul stock exchange on September 17.

stories.title: ‎US oil reserves fall to lowest since 1982

en.title: US oil reserves fall to lowest since 1982
en.summary: US crude oil inventories in the Strategic Petroleum Reserve dropped to 284.6 million barrels, the lowest level since October 1982. The decline resulted from releasing approximately 172 million barrels to address market demand amid reduced Middle East supplies.

stories.title: ‎MENA’s Market Leaders Connect with Global and Regional Capital at EFG Hermes’ 12th Annual London Investor Conference

en.title: MENA's Market Leaders Connect with Global and Regional Capital at EFG Hermes' 12th Annual London Investor Conference
en.summary: EFG Hermes held its 12th annual London Investor Conference from September 21-24, 2026, at Emirates Stadium, bringing together prominent Middle Eastern and North African companies and global institutional investors for investment discussions.

stories.title: ‎Al Battal Factory outlines measures to address accumulated losses

en.title: Al Battal Factory outlines measures to address accumulated losses
en.summary: Al Battal Factory for Chemical Industries announced a plan to address accumulated losses totaling 74.29% of its capital through insurance compensation collection and shareholder equity restructuring. The board approved measures intended to gradually improve financial performance.
